centroid of the two opposing screw-mount tag centers

notes: IDs 31 and 25 were assigned to the L4 hip and knee respectively from the operator's placement plus rigid tracking during the 2026-09-02 stand/turn/lower video.

During that video, tag 31 stayed nearest the adjacent hip-lid tag (median 62.8 px, IQR 0.4 px) and tag 25 stayed nearest the adjacent knee-lid tag (median 57.6 px, IQR 11.6 px over 665 co-visible frames).
IDs 16/20 are provisionally assigned to the hip and 17/21 to the knee from their observed placement.
Measure tag-to-joint-axis transforms before treating the reported centroids as mechanical joint centers.
